---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
AGStates == {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate}
AGHold == {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
AGInitOff == {InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate}
AGSelected == {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt}
AGRespOwn == {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}
AGInitOwn == {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction}
AGAfterSend == {InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
AGAfterWait == {InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
AGRespPending == {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderReactivate}
AGTyped ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> AGStates]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN
AGSent(q) == actionneeded[q] /\ pc[q] \notin AGRespOwn /\ (interrupt[q] \/ pc[q] \in AGRespPending)
AGBlocked(q) ==
  /\ AGSent(q)
  /\ pc[q] \notin {MainCheck, MainChoose, InitiatorDeactivate}
AGNeeds(q) ==
  /\ pc[q] # Boot
  /\ (pc[q] # InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb \/ userpmap[q] # writepmap[q])
  /\ (\/ ~actionneeded[q]
      \/ pc[q] \in {MainCheck, MainChoose, InitiatorDeactivate}
      \/ (pc[q] \in (AGInitOff \cup {MainHandleInterrupt}) /\ ~interrupt[q])
      \/ pc[q] \in {ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction})
AGTypeInv ==
  AGTyped

AGErrorInv ==
  error = FALSE

AGActiveInv ==
  \A p \in Processor :
       active[p] = (pc[p] \notin (AGInitOff \cup {ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate}))

AGMapInv ==
  \A m \in PMap : plock[m] = (\E p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AGHold /\ writepmap[p] = m)

AGUniqueInv ==
  \A p,q \in Processor :
       (pc[p] \in AGHold /\ pc[q] \in AGHold /\ writepmap[p] = writepmap[q]) => p=q

AGActionInv ==
  \A q \in Processor : actionlock[q] =
       (pc[q] \in AGRespOwn \/ (\E p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AGInitOwn /\ currentcpu[p] = q))

AGSelectInv ==
  \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AGSelected =>
       /\ currentcpu[p] # p
       /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot
       /\ (pc[p] # InitiatorCheckCpuPmap => userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p])

AGExclusiveInv ==
  \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in (AGInitOwn \cup {InitiatorInterrupt}) => pc[currentcpu[p]] \notin AGRespOwn

AGNeededInv ==
  \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} => actionneeded[currentcpu[p]]

AGTodoInv ==
  \A p,q \in Processor : pc[p] \in AGHold /\ todo[p][q] => q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot

AGSentInv ==
  \A p,q \in Processor :
      (pc[p] \in AGHold /\ q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
        /\ ((pc[p] \in AGAfterSend \/
              (pc[p] \in ({InitiatorForSend} \cup AGSelected) /\ ~todo[p][q] /\
                (pc[p] = InitiatorForSend \/ currentcpu[p] # q))) => AGSent(q))
        /\ ((pc[p] \in AGAfterWait \/ (pc[p] = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence /\ ~todo[p][q])) => AGBlocked(q))

AGCoherentInv ==
  \A q \in Processor : AGNeeds(q) => tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]

AGInv ==
  /\ AGTypeInv
  /\ AGErrorInv
  /\ AGActiveInv
  /\ AGMapInv
  /\ AGUniqueInv
  /\ AGActionInv
  /\ AGSelectInv
  /\ AGExclusiveInv
  /\ AGNeededInv
  /\ AGTodoInv
  /\ AGSentInv
  /\ AGCoherentInv
